findings.confidence: high source for missing subprocess confinement; consequence conditional on restrictive scope and installed app
findings.requirement: Restricted tools must not gain process-host authority through CLI app family
findings.trigger: run_cli_app enabled and a file/network-capable installed CLI invoked inside restricted workspace without independent OS sandbox
findings.consequence: Child process accepts model-selected path/URL args and retains host filesystem/network rights despite cwd policy
findings.smallest_alternative: Reuse S01/S02/T01 native sandbox process owner, else disable CLI app execution for restricted managed turns.

findings.confidence: high source for literal click; external effect page-dependent
findings.requirement: Crawler read/navigation role must not click or trigger stateful authenticated page actions
findings.trigger: enabled crawler expand on details/summary/aria-expanded=false selector, possibly authenticated page
findings.consequence: Calls element.click() while action class says read_navigation; page handlers may alter remote account state
findings.smallest_alternative: Remove DOM click or split explicit state-changing expansion behind a separate approval policy.

findings.classification: Unbounded captured subprocess output before presentation truncation
findings.requirement: Installed CLI tools must cap process output capture, not merely displayed text
findings.trigger: Installed CLI outputs high-volume stdout or stderr during allowed runtime
findings.consequence: capture_output=True buffers the full stream(s) before _truncate/display
findings.smallest_alternative: Bound streaming stdout/stderr capture and use owned subprocess cancellation.

findings.confidence: high source for merge/label; collision unverified
findings.requirement: App installer metadata and trust label must derive from the same explicit source
findings.trigger: Optional extensions registry collides with harness/public lower-case app name
findings.consequence: Later record overrides executable install/update metadata while merged source labeled cli-anything
findings.smallest_alternative: Forbid cross-source executable-field overwrite or use source-qualified app IDs and reflect actual installer source.

final_discussion_questions.text: Should run_cli_app use native/sandbox process owner for all restricted/managed turns, or be unavailable in them?
Must crawler expand be purely non-eventful inspection, or can approved state-changing actions exist outside the read-only crawler?
What are trust/source collision rules and package pinning requirements for CLI app registries?
Which shared process owner should cap stdout/stderr and descendant lifetime?
What DNS pinning, socket identity and authenticated browser profile boundaries are required on Windows/Linux?
Should optional feature and CLI app installed-state/config writes have transactional receipts and serializable commit semantics?
